Lots of apps to check — this can take a minute. Everything is fine.

Probably fine — worth a quick look

This app has the exact powers that banking-scam spyware uses: it can watch your screen, read your OTPs, and stop you from removing it. If you did not install it on purpose, treat it as dangerous and remove it.
This app holds powerful permissions that scam apps often misuse. If you do not clearly recognise and trust it, you should remove it.
This app shows one warning sign. It may be perfectly fine if it is something you installed on purpose — like a password manager or a screen reader. Check that you recognise it.
We did not find strong warning signs for this app.
This is a built-in or well-known app. We show it only so you can see the full picture.
Don\'t worry — tap the button below and we will walk you through the fix, one step at a time.
Or do it yourself, step by step
For your safety, Android only lets YOU turn these settings off — no app can do it for you. Saavdhan takes you straight to the right screen; you make the final tap.
From here you can Force Stop, change permissions, or uninstall.
In the list that opens, find this app and switch it OFF.
Find this app in the list and tap Deactivate, then come back.
Saavdhan works fully offline. It never connects to the internet and never sends your data anywhere.
Saavdhan is allowed to run in the background. It can alert you as soon as a dangerous new app appears.
Your phone\'s battery saver may stop Saavdhan from watching in the background. Tap below, find Saavdhan in the list, and allow it.
The background check hasn\'t run yet.
Your phone (%1$s) might stop Saavdhan from protecting you in the background. Please allow it to run in the background.
Warns you when a newly installed app looks dangerous.
Is someone on the phone telling you to do this?
If yes, hang up now and do not share any OTP. %1$s was just installed and looks dangerous. Tap to see what to do.
Did someone just ask you to turn on a setting?
If yes, stop and do not share any OTP. %1$s now has powers that scam apps misuse. Tap to see what to do.
Find \"%1$s\" in this list and turn it OFF.
Find \"%1$s\", tap it, then choose Deactivate.
Shows step-by-step help on top of the Settings screen. Asks for the \"draw over other apps\" permission once.
Turn on Airplane mode so the app can\'t send your information while you clean up.
Or swipe down from the top and tap the Airplane mode button.
This app can watch your screen. Switch its Accessibility OFF first.
This app has admin power that blocks removal. Deactivate it so you can uninstall.
Now remove the app from your phone.
From a DIFFERENT device, change your bank and UPI passwords. Watch for any payment requests or auto-pay mandates you did not set up, and cancel them.
Well done. One last thing: secure your accounts from another device.

Some scam apps block these screens. Restart your phone in Safe Mode — it turns off all downloaded apps so you can remove this one. Press and hold the power button, then press and hold \"Power off\" until \"Reboot to safe mode\" appears, and tap OK.
If nothing else works, a factory reset erases the phone and removes the app. Back up your photos to a computer first. Then open Settings and search for \"Reset\".
Could not open that screen on this phone. Please open Settings and find it yourself.
